name: ffxiv-road-to-evercold-free-login-nov-16
lines:
أطلقت سكوير (Square Enix)
أطول حملة لعب مجاني للعبة

للاعبين الذين انتهى اشتراكهم
قبل 150 يومًا على الأقل

الوصول المبكر إلى Evercold
في 19 فبراير 2027
spoken: أطلقت سكوير (Square Enix) أطول حملة لعب مجاني للعبة للاعبين الذين انتهى اشتراكهم قبل 150 يومًا على الأقل. والوصول المبكر إلى إضافة Evercold يبدأ في 19 فبراير 2027.
headline:
حتى 30 يومًا مجانًا
في FINAL FANTASY XIV
label: رسمي
bed_reason: Square Enix's vertical Evercold promo (lds-img.finalfantasyxiv.com, 1080x1920, 35 s) has no audio stream; the full trailers on the Evercold page are YouTube embeds only (yt-dlp asks for a sign-in), and Steam's FINAL FANTASY XIV trailers are A Realm Reborn era, unrelated to the campaign

angle.hook: the longest free login campaign in FINAL FANTASY XIV's history: up to 30 days free
angle.why_now: it started today, 16 Nov 2026, at 12:00 a.m. PST (12:00 Dubai), and runs to 14 Jan 2027
angle.what_it_means_here: players who left the game can come back free if their last subscription ended at least 150 days ago, ahead of the Evercold expansion

reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: yes: Square Enix campaign page na.finalfantasyxiv.com/evercoldcampaign read 12:17Z (schedule, eligibility, 30 days), Lodestone topic and Evercold page (early access 19 Feb 2027) read 12:16Z
reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: ledger find recorded; earlier FFXIV posts were the 35M milestone and outage compensation, not this campaign
reel_check.STORY TYPE free: yes: what (up to 30 days free), who (owners with no game time, 150 days since last subscription), when (16 Nov to 14 Jan 2027), why (Evercold)
reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: يبدأ الوصول المبكر for early access
reel_check.SOUND: yes: our bed, publisher clip has no audio (bed_reason)
reel_check.PICTURE: footage first: yes: Square Enix's own vertical cut, no crop
reel_check.PICTURE: nothing graphic: yes: crystal, flowers, snowfield, figures; no violence

decision_log.L1: flowers then frozen field: the campaign announcement
decision_log.L2: lone figure in the snow: returning players
